ui.hero.heading: Encrypt your own text
ui.hero.intro: Type up to 16 bytes and follow AES-128 round by round, with the example key from FIPS 197. Nothing plays on its own: use the step buttons or drag the timeline.
ui.hero.exampleNote: Showing the example plaintext from FIPS 197, App. C.1. Type above to encrypt your own text.
ui.hero.paddingNote_one: + 1 zero byte of padding (marked) fills the block to 16 bytes.
ui.hero.paddingNote_other: + {{count}} zero bytes of padding (marked) fill the block to 16 bytes.
ui.hero.noPadding: No padding: your text fills the whole 16-byte block.
